name: 37-add-reasoning-content-to-tool-calls
description: addReasoningContentToToolCalls (prompt-converters.js:1377-1389). Only an assistant turn with an **array** `tool_calls` and **no** `reasoning_content` key gets the empty-string field, so the four turns here cover each guard: one is stamped, one already carries `reasoning_content: null` and is left alone (the check is `'reasoning_content' in message`, a presence test, not a truthy one), one has `tool_calls` as a plain string rather than an array, and one has no `tool_calls` at all. `reasoning_content` is inserted at the end of the object, so the recorded key order shows it was appended.
